title: The Jolty Vest

sources.title: Countershock
markers: | description = When the wearer takes damage while having {{Cond|Lightning Charges}}, the attacker must succeed a [[Dexterity]] {{Saving Throw}} or become {{Cond|Shocked}}.

summary: Medium Armour shocks attackers while you have Lightning Charges.

fields.Defence: Medium Armour proficiency. AC 14 plus Dexterity modifier, capped at +2. Reduce incoming Slashing damage by 1.
fields.Countershock: When you take damage while charged, the attacker makes DC 14 Dexterity save or is Shocked for 1 turn. Shocked blocks spending the Reaction resource and gives Disadvantage on Dexterity checks and saves. Lightning damage resistance alone does not prevent it.
fields.Acquisition: Brem after Find the Missing Shipment.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and exact item and dependency citations.
